40:50.text: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate
, but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error

40:51.text: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -

40:52.text: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home

40:53.text: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

40:54.text: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.

40:55.text: . Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin
with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

40:56.text: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without
evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride,
which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.

40:57.text: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

40:58.text: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.
